create_audio_classification_task: create an AudioClassificationTask instance with a config to classify audio into labeled classes
load_labels_from_csv: load class labels from a label_descriptors.csv file mapping label names to integer indices
load_dataset_with_labels: load an audio dataset split and wrap it with class target labels for multi-class classification
calculate_classification_stats: calculate per-class average precision statistics from model output predictions and ground truth targets
reduce_metrics_with_mAP: reduce validation logging outputs to compute mean average precision (mAP) across all classes
